# پیکربندی کامل پروفایل آزموده‌شده

مقادیر باید با سورس و binary همان نسخه تطبیق داده شوند؛ کپی بخشی از این جدول به firmware نامعلوم، بازتولید آزمون نیست. تغییر این مقادیر model identity را تغییر می‌دهد.

## واحدها، frameها و قرارداد نام‌گذاری نسخهٔ جاری

مبنای محاسبات SI است: مکان متر، سرعت متر بر ثانیه، شتاب متر بر مجذور ثانیه، gyro رادیان بر ثانیه، زمان ثانیه، جرم کیلوگرم، نیرو نیوتن، چگالی کیلوگرم بر متر مکعب و زاویهٔ داخلی رادیان. پارامترهای FCU مانند `Q_A_ANGLE_MAX` و حدود گزارش‌شدهٔ نرخ در درجه‌اند و هنگام استفاده تبدیل می‌شوند.

frame ناوبری NED است: North، East، Down. ارتفاع بالای مبدأ برابر `-p_D` و climb-rate مثبت رو به بالاست. quaternion با ترتیب `w,x,y,z` از بدنهٔ FRD به NED نگه‌داری می‌شود؛ کتابخانهٔ SciPy ترتیب `x,y,z,w` می‌خواهد. قاب VTOL با دوران ثابت `Ry(-90deg)` از قاب بدنهٔ دم‌نشین ساخته می‌شود. اشتباه‌گرفتن این قاب با roll/pitch هواپیمای افقی، علت یک ناسازگاری مقداردهی اولیه بود.

timestampهای source از زمان boot/شبیه‌ساز به ثانیه تبدیل می‌شوند؛ freshness دریافت با `time.monotonic()` سنجیده می‌شود. مقایسهٔ مستقیم monotonic با datetime یا retime کردن prediction با زمان wall مجاز نیست. forcing زمان epoch مقید دارد و query MicroMet برابر epoch به‌علاوهٔ زمان شبیه‌ساز است.

در MAVLink، `lat_int/lon_int` در واحد درجه ضربدر ۱e۷، altitude بسته‌های origin برحسب میلی‌متر و فیلد `SIM_STATE.alt` برحسب متر است. تفسیر float lat/lon این producer برای ارزیابی دقیق جای extensionهای int32 را نمی‌گیرد. تبدیل UTM/جغرافیایی در readerهای مربوط انجام می‌شود؛ فاصلهٔ ژئودزیک مقصد در ارزیابی با WGS84 محاسبه می‌شود.

XML بومی JSBSim واحدهای fps، lbf و lb-ft دارد؛ مولد از `0.3048 m/ft`، `4.4482216152605 N/lbf` و `1.3558179483314 Nm/lbft` استفاده می‌کند. copy کردن ضریب SI در expression بومی بدون تبدیل، تغییر فیزیک است. چهار مؤلفهٔ u_cmd نیز «واحد عملگر فیزیکی» نیستند؛ سطح pilot/GUI و bounds قراردادی خود را دارند.


## فایل `layer6_v20261007_1032/configs/native_realtime_vtol.parm`

````text
# Phoenix dual-rotor tailsitter - ArduPlane SITL parameters
Q_ENABLE 1
Q_TAILSIT_ENABLE 1
Q_FRAME_CLASS 10
Q_TAILSIT_MOTMX 0

SERVO1_FUNCTION 77
SERVO2_FUNCTION 78
SERVO3_FUNCTION 73
SERVO4_FUNCTION 74

SERVO1_MIN 1000
SERVO1_TRIM 1500
SERVO1_MAX 2000
SERVO2_MIN 1000
SERVO2_TRIM 1500
SERVO2_MAX 2000
SERVO3_MIN 1000
SERVO3_TRIM 1000
SERVO3_MAX 2000
SERVO4_MIN 1000
SERVO4_TRIM 1000
SERVO4_MAX 2000

RUDD_DT_GAIN 0
AHRS_EKF_TYPE 3
ARSPD_TYPE 100
BATT_MONITOR 4
BATT_CAPACITY 2200
TERRAIN_ENABLE 0
TERRAIN_FOLLOW 0
ARSPD_USE 1
ARSPD_SKIP_CAL 1
ARSPD_AUTOCAL 0
INS_GYR_CAL 0

INS_ACCOFFS_X 0.00001
INS_ACCOFFS_Y 0.00001
INS_ACCOFFS_Z 0.00001
INS_ACCSCAL_X 1.0
INS_ACCSCAL_Y 1.0
INS_ACCSCAL_Z 1.0

INS_ACC2OFFS_X 0.00001
INS_ACC2OFFS_Y 0.00001
INS_ACC2OFFS_Z 0.00001
INS_ACC2SCAL_X 1.0
INS_ACC2SCAL_Y 1.0
INS_ACC2SCAL_Z 1.0

# GNSS-denied SITL. AHRS_EKF_TYPE=3 uses the sensor EKF inner-loop attitude
# backend; TDDT navigation uses only its approved IMU/mag/baro/pitot sensors.
SIM_GPS1_ENABLE 0
SIM_GPS2_ENABLE 0
SIM_GPS3_ENABLE 0
SIM_GPS4_ENABLE 0


# No GNSS receivers are installed in this simulation navigation profile.
GPS1_TYPE 0
GPS2_TYPE 0
# Prototype commissioning baseline: no artificial triangular gyro-bias ramp.
# Stock sensor noise and measured gyro/accelerometer bias handling remain active.
SIM_DRIFT_SPEED 0

# Elevon signs: positive AP pitch demand requires negative physical deflection.
SERVO1_REVERSED 1
SERVO2_REVERSED 1

# Native .65kg dual-rotor commissioning: bounded inner-loop bandwidth, no
# unqualified fixed-wing default feedforward on VTOL propwash surfaces.
Q_A_ANG_RLL_P 1.8
Q_A_ANG_PIT_P 1.8
Q_A_ANG_YAW_P 1.5
Q_A_RAT_RLL_P 0.04
Q_A_RAT_RLL_I 0.02
Q_A_RAT_RLL_D 0.001
Q_A_RAT_RLL_FF 0
Q_A_RAT_RLL_IMAX 0.12
Q_A_RAT_PIT_P 0.16
Q_A_RAT_PIT_I 0.06
Q_A_RAT_PIT_D 0.001
Q_A_RAT_PIT_FF 0
Q_A_RAT_PIT_IMAX 0.12
Q_A_RAT_YAW_P 0.12
Q_A_RAT_YAW_I 0.03
Q_A_RAT_YAW_D 0.001
Q_A_RAT_YAW_FF 0
Q_A_RAT_YAW_IMAX 0.12

# No GNSS, external navigation, optical flow or odometry aiding for EKF3.
EK3_ENABLE 1
EK2_ENABLE 0
EK3_SRC1_POSXY 0
EK3_SRC1_VELXY 0
EK3_SRC1_POSZ 1
EK3_SRC1_VELZ 0
EK3_SRC1_YAW 1

# Start disarmed in VTOL: fixed-wing EKF bootstrap explicitly requires GPS lock.
# QHOVER clears the fly-forward assumption; normal EKF/arming checks remain on.
INITIAL_MODE 18

# Mode ownership belongs to the Digital Pilot. An idle RC mode switch must not
# overwrite INITIAL_MODE with a fixed-wing MANUAL slot during EKF bootstrap.
FLTMODE_CH 0

# Keep a healthy, initialized attitude/vertical EKF in VTOL without XY aiding.
# ArduPlane's DCM fallback otherwise insists on horizontal navigation validity.
AHRS_OPTIONS 2
````

## فایل `TDOC_v20260911_2052/configs/tdoc.yaml`

SHA‑256: `2227f59057032c1ad4f28b32e3532af48b2db868f46c41b887f3bb76c9384690`.

````yaml
package:
  version: 2026.9.11.2052
  orchestration_version: TDOC-runtime-v1
  formalism: TDDT_Dynamic_NTwin_TDOC_details_FA_v4.md
  invocation_contract: section 41.1 / Ready -> TDOC Trigger -> Invoke -> VersionedRoute
# External package/module addresses are intentionally absent here.
# Source configs/environment.sh before any TDOC command; it is the single address authority.
addressing:
  authority: configs/environment.sh
  external_path_fallbacks: false
unit_adapter:
  expected_package: TDOC_ISO_Universal_Unit_Conversion_Standard20260824_0914
  minimum_api_version: 2.2.0
  binding_owner: TDOC/RuntimeScheduler
  conversion_owner: Layer3.1/TDOCAdapter
  double_normalization: prohibited
  authoritative_env: TDDT_UNIT_ADAPTER_ROOT
  layer3_binding_field: Layer3Config.paths.tdoc_root
  tdoc_package_root: current package directory (automatic)
layers:
  layer1:
    enabled: true
    implementation: physical_event_ingress
  layer2:
    enabled: true
    implementation: external_direct_api
    require_twins: [MESA_NAV, WingMPET, MicroMetTwin]
  layer3:
    enabled: true
    implementation: external_layer3_engine
    config: configs/configuration_boulder.yaml
    forbid_fmu_runtime_owner: true
  layer4:
    enabled: true
    implementation: external_layer4_engine
    config: configs/configuration_boulder.yaml
  layer5:
    enabled: true
    implementation: external_layer5_engine
    config: configs/configuration_phoenix.yaml
    expected_package: layer5_v20260911_1510
    expected_version: 2026.9.11.1510
    default_learning_mode: OFFLINE_SE
  layer6:
    enabled: true
    implementation: external_layer6_client_gateway
    modes: [ONLINE_JSBSIM]
    online_only: true
    online:
      transport: Layer6Client_GUI_MAVLink
      execution_profile: closed_loop_sitl
      authoritative_env: TDDT_LAYER6_ROOT
      expected_package: layer6_v20261007_1032
      expected_version: 2026.10.7.0937
      pipeline: Layer6Client -> GUI -> MAVLink -> ArduPilot SITL -> JSBSim
      feedback_destination: Layer7
      require_layer6_package: true
      direct_pwm: false
      guidance_sequence_config: configs/online_guidance_sequence.yaml
      guidance_sequence_owner: TDOC/RuntimeScheduler
      endpoint: 127.0.0.1:14661
      gui_endpoint: 127.0.0.1:14660
      start_if_needed: true
      startup_timeout_s: 30.0
      execution_confirmation_timeout_s: 5.0
      telemetry_max_age_s: 0.2
      imu_max_age_s: 0.15
      # Wait across the 1 Hz wind producer's pending/readback interval, then
      # acquire new observations. This does not extend any sample's freshness.
      telemetry_resample_timeout_s: 2.0
      require_bound_environment: true
      require_live_channels: true
      require_fcu_estimator_ready: true
      require_body_attitude_quaternion: true
      ground_contact_policy: phoenix-fourfoot-no-fixture-r3.05-v1
      ground_arm_bootstrap: true
      origin_tolerance_m: 50.0
      gps_role: validation_reference_only
      navigation_sensor_source: MAVLink/SCALED_IMU/BODY_FRD
      execution_rate_hz: 30.0
      stop_owned_stack_on_close: true
  offline_training:
    route: Layer5 -> TDOC -> Layer2
    layer6_in_path: false
    feedback_field: layer5_training_feedback
    close_training_loop: true
  online_training:
    mode: ONLINE_JSBSIM
    require_finalized_offline_setd: true
    setd_owner: external Layer5 KStore
    handoff_owner: TDOC/RuntimeScheduler
    execution_transport: Layer6Client_GUI_MAVLink
    feedback_layer: Layer7
    layer5_online_persistent_write: false
    layer7_persistent_learning_authority: true
    continuous_cycle_semantics: "--online-cycles is a maximum iteration count, not a mission count"
    episode_semantics: "--online-episodes/--online-missions repeats origin-to-destination missions with a per-episode cycle safety cap"
    default_max_cycles_per_episode: 320
    no_actuation_stall_abort_cycles: 5
    auto_commission_if_not_ready: false
    demo_aligned_preparation: true
    cycle_timing_excludes_episode_startup: true
    commissioning_semantics: "bounded SITL-only held-physics pilot-domain/mixer/trim validation; no direct PWM and no nonzero qLPV correction authorization"
    auto_cycle_budget:
      enabled: true
      offline_budget_preferred: true
      margin_factor: 1.20
      reserve_cycles: 20
      minimum_cycles: 60
      maximum_cycles: 3600
      fallback_nominal_ground_speed_m_s: 15.0
  layer7:
    enabled: true
    implementation: external_layer7_side_module
    config: configs/default.json
    expected_package: layer7_v20260901_0921
    expected_version: 0.3.0
    expected_contract: tdoc-layer7-v2
    trigger_owner: TDOC
    direct_actuation: false
    feedback_routes: [Layer2, Layer3.1, Layer3.2, Layer3.3]
    safe_commit_owner: TDOC
    structural_validation: fail_closed
scheduler:
  fast_dt_s: 1.0
  meso_fast_steps: 3
  slow_meso_windows: 2
  trigger_owner: TDOC/RuntimeScheduler
runtime:
  root: runtime
  strict: true
  provenance: events/invocations.jsonl
  on_not_ready: hold
  require_atomic_snapshot: true
  require_traceable_invocation: true
  prohibit_direct_layer_ownership: true
  storage:
    knowledge_compression: gzip
    chunk_records: 64
    chunk_uncompressed_bytes: 1048576
    per_layer_runtime_archive: true
  immutable_external_packages: true
deadlines:
  enforcement: fail_closed
  clock: monotonic
  layer2_s: 5.0
  layer3_s: 5.0
  layer4_s: 2.0
  # Full-horizon L2/L3/WingMPET replay is a non-actuating terminal-schedule
  # transaction. The <2 s control-segment deadline above remains unchanged.
  # PRE_RELEASE is outside the control hot path and may include full-horizon
  # WingMPET replay plus audit flush on constrained edge CPUs. Its deadline must
  # bound that verification transaction rather than spuriously reject valid FF
  # evidence at the 12 s process-time boundary.
  # Isolated cold-start FMU verification sends no flight command. Its measured
  # Native startup cost exceeds 30 s; live command deadlines remain separate.
  layer4_pre_release_s: 120.0
  layer5_s: 5.0
  layer6_s: 15.0
  layer7_s: 5.0
  offline_loop_s: 50.0
reporting:
  output_dir: reports/visualization
  terrain_grid_n: 90
  source: TDOC runtime artifacts only
  generate_2d: true
  generate_3d: true
  layer4_forecast_semantics: forecast, not executed path

# Layer6 service owns command latching/cadence. Execution rate is configured at
# layers.layer6.online.execution_rate_hz; Layer5's deadline is never extended.

# TDOC-RTMO complementary mission orchestration (TDOC_RTMO_Complement_FA_v2).
# This policy changes orchestration only; Layer2..Layer7 internals remain authoritative.
tdoc:
  realtime:
    enabled: true
    profile: native-sensor-vtol-prototype-v1
    stationary_calibration_s: 60.0
    route_height_m: 10.0
    route_speed_m_s: 6.0
  knowledge_policy:
    # Versioned OFFLINE evidence prior. It never grants FINAL or execution authority.
    artifact: knowledge/policy/online_policy.json.gz
    offline_timeline: reports/offline/mission/MISSION_TIMELINE.csv
  rtmo:
    enabled: true
    mission:
      phase_order: [on_ground, vertical_takeoff, hover, transition_forward, climb, cruise, turn, approach, transition_back, vertical_landing, touchdown]
      require_all_phase_capabilities: false
      admission_policy: PHASE_LOCAL_RUNTIME_RELEASE
      far_phase_missing_is_warning: true
      start_phase: on_ground
      completion_phase: touchdown
    realtime:
      min_control_hz: 10.0
      max_control_period_s: 0.1
      max_sim_time_jump_s: 0.15
      plant_clock_authority: layer6_mavlink_ardupilot
      use_monotonic_deadlines: true
      latency_window_samples: 20000
      min_executed_samples_for_p99_claim: 1000
    authority:
      navigation: mesa_std
      simulator_truth: diagnostic_only
      terminal_state: mesa_std
    initial_navigation:
      # Once at the disarmed ground boundary: measured support force supplies
      # roll/pitch; mission-known origin/yaw remain unchanged. No truth injection.
      attitude_source: native_ground_imu
      ground_calibration_seconds: 5.0
    capability:
      require_live_registry: true
      registry_path: runtime/rtmo/capability_registry.json.gz
      reports_are_audit_only: true
    l4_artifacts:
      reuse_only_if_verified: true
      require_phase_match: true
      require_envelope_match: true
      require_version_match: true
      require_freshness: true
      require_live_certificate_guard: true
      synthetic_final_forbidden: true
      fast_path_reuse: true
      refresh_lane: meso_async
      # The committable first move is exactly one executor/plant transaction.
      # The slower forecast horizon is retained and every row remains FF-gated.
      commit_segment_s: 0.1
      # Refresh is meso/background work. Starting it every two executor ticks makes
      # the CPU-bound WingMPET replay contend with the fast lane. Fifteen seconds
      # also prevents overlap with the one-time post-bootstrap plant-clock rebase,
      # while leaving fifteen seconds before max_age_s. Phase/envelope/version gates
      # still force an immediate fail-closed bootstrap whenever reuse is inadmissible.
      refresh_after_s: 15.0
      refresh_envelope_fraction: 0.75
      max_age_s: 30.0
      position_tolerance_m: 20.0
      velocity_tolerance_m_s: 4.0
      no_full_fidelity_compute_in_fast_path: true
    execution:
      mixer_authority: ArduPilot SITL
      l6_failure_policy: fail_stop
      direct_pwm: false
      direct_motor_injection: false
      direct_elevon_injection: false
      direct_jsbsim_actuator_injection: false
    command_lease:
      hold_ticks: 3
      derive_from_fast_tick: true
      release_on_stale: true
    persistence:
      hot_path_sync_heavy_writes: false
      bounded_queue: true
      max_queue_records: 256
      flush_timeout_s: 30.0
    run_coherence:
      immutable_run_context: true
      reject_cross_run_merge: true
````
